articles.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
articles.snippet: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

articles.title: A memecoin making app becomes crypto’s top fee generators as Robinhood Chain activity explodes
articles.snippet: Users paid nearly $6 million in a day to create and trade tokens through Pons, more than they paid to use Pump or Hyperliquid, and even more than they paid to use Robinhood Chain itself.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin jumps above $81,000 as rates fall, dollar weakens
articles.snippet: The government's employment data (due tomorrow) is usually the main economic report of the month, but this time around it's next week's inflation numbers that will decide Fed policy.

articles.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $78,000 as pons and arbitrum extend Robinhood Chain rally
articles.snippet: BTC rose 0.76% since midnight as a softer dollar lifted equities and metals alongside crypto, while ARB and PONS pushed higher for a third session.

articles.title: CFTC asks judge to dismiss CME lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
articles.snippet: The regulator claims the dispute is "much ado about nothing," noting that the order allows any designated contract market, including CME, to list these products.
